All 5 tests are now passing. The fix updated the `slugify` function to properly handle consecutive non-alphanumeric characters by replacing them with a single hyphen and removing any leading or trailing hyphens using `text.strip("-")`.

**Summary of the fix:**
- Changed from `return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")` 
- To: Replace consecutive non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, then strip leading/trailing hyphens

The key change was adding `.strip("-")` to remove any remaining hyphens at the start or end of the string after the regex substitution.
